environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated account 555666777888 under OU 'ou-r3st-workloads'. Task role arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/microservice-staging-role has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/EnforcedBoundary-v2) that contains an explicit Deny on s3:PutObject for any resource NOT matching arn:aws:s3:::staging-approved-*. Additionally, the OU has SCP 'scp-restrict-s3-exfil' which denies s3:PutObject when aws:ResourceAccount is not 555666777888 (preventing cross-account writes). The permission boundary also denies kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey unless the kms:ViaService condition matches s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. The service runs behind an internal ALB with no public ingress; access requires VPN + mTLS client cert validated at the ALB listener.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Explicit Deny on s3:PutObject unless resource matches arn:aws:s3:::staging-approved-*; Deny kms:Decrypt unless kms:ViaService=s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
config.network: Internal ALB, private subnets only, mTLS required at listener, VPN-only access
